entries.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
entries.snippet: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

entries.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv warehouse
entries.snippet: An investigation has been launched into the storage of weapons in the deopt near a residential area.

entries.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
entries.snippet: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.

entries.title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
entries.snippet: A woman who rented out homes to two al-Qaeda members speaks publicly for the first time - to the BBC.

entries.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
entries.snippet: Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".

entries.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
entries.snippet: The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.

entries.title: Close race as Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
entries.snippet: Turbulent international affairs have brought the vote forward, but the campaign has focused more on Iceland's vital fishing industry.

entries.title: Ex-White House teleprompter operator ordered to pay $172,000 for Trump speech bets
entries.snippet: The staffer was found to have used his prior knowledge of the president's speeches to place lucrative bets.

entries.title: Dutch health institute issues 'red alert' over Trump-shaped ecstasy pills
entries.snippet: The drugs have a delayed effect which "increases the risk of overdose", the health institute says.

entries.title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
entries.snippet: Anne Lindboe, the mayor of Norway's capital, had planned to marry her fiance on Friday.

entries.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
entries.snippet: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

entries.title: Canada poaches dozens of top US researchers for its universities
entries.snippet: Researchers in fields like climate and medicine are being lured north by new research funding.

entries.title: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says
entries.snippet: Kai Wegner says the German capital and city-state would not cave in to a ransom demand for data stolen in a cyber-attack.

entries.title: Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight
entries.snippet: Police are hunting two suspects they believe bought a ticket for the exhibition to get at the jewellery.

entries.title: Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final
entries.snippet: Experts examined the use of forced contraception on the Inuit community during the 1960s and 70s.

entries.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
entries.snippet: A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.

entries.title: World's youngest reigning traditional monarch dies aged 34
entries.snippet: King Oyo ascended to the throne of Uganda's Tooro kingdom when he was just three years old.

entries.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
entries.snippet: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

entries.title: Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital
entries.snippet: The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.

entries.title: Shootings surge as drug gangs torment Brussels
entries.snippet: This year alone there have been more than 65 shootings in the Belgian capital, as drug crime soars.

entries.title: Opinion: Remembering Dolly Parton
entries.snippet: She said she wasn't offended by dumb blonde jokes because "I know I'm not dumb...and I also know I'm not blonde!" We take a moment to remember the smart, funny and uniquely talented Dolly Parton.

entries.title: The bridges of Rwanda open up new worlds
entries.snippet: A charity built 96 bridges to connect communities separated by rivers and gorges. A new study looks at the life-changing impact of a concrete-and-steel pedestrian crossing.

entries.title: Lights out, Instagram off? The changes to Meta for teens could be a big deal
entries.snippet: Researchers and advocates are applauding the changes that Meta agreed to make for minors on Instagram and Facebook. Cutting kids off at night and during the school day are two big changes.

entries.title: Trump cuts to science advisory boards have long-lasting consequences, researchers say
entries.snippet: The federal government recruits top experts to volunteer to advise on pressing research issues of the day. Since President Trump took office, hundreds of these experts have been dismissed.

entries.title: How America celebrated and mourned Dolly Parton, in Nashville and beyond

entries.title: Why is one WNBA team calling in national security experts?
entries.snippet: The WNBA's popularity has risen in recent years, but so have threats and abuse directed at its players. One team is taking a novel approach to this, by partnering with national security specialists.

entries.title: Trump says U.S. has entered deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
entries.snippet: President Trump says his administration has entered a sweeping agreement with Venezuela that could give the U.S. access to vast amounts of the South American country's untapped oil reserves, at cost.

entries.title: Sae Joon Park, a Purple Heart veteran who self-deported, receives pardon
entries.snippet: His removal order was triggered by two convictions from over 15 years ago, when he struggled with untreated PTSD. New York's governor said Park earned a "second chance through rehabilitation."

entries.title: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
entries.snippet: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

entries.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh warns inflation is too high, sparking bets rate hikes are coming
entries.snippet: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his commitment to fighting inflation in a major speech — raising expectations that rate hikes may be coming, though he did not clearly spell out a path going forward.

entries.title: Trump says U.S. has entered deal with Venezuela to control 65 billion barrels of its oil reserves
entries.snippet: The announcement of the deal comes nearly nine months after the U.S. military at Trump's direction carried out an operation to capture Venezuela's president Nicolás Maduro and spirit him to the United States to face federal narcoterrorism and drug trafficking charges.

entries.snippet: Three days after a catastrophic wall of water, mud and rock tore through Nepal's Himalayan valleys, the scale of the disaster is still coming into focus. At least 579 people are now confirmed dead, nearly 2,000 remain missing, and the danger is not over. Authorities are closely w

entries.title: NASA is preparing to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Here's what to know

entries.title: Fed Chair Warsh not ruling out interest rate hike amid inflation concerns
entries.snippet: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said there is still work to do on inflation. At the Fed's annual economic symposium in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, Warsh also said that although he is not committed to a rate hike, he is not ruling it out. Amna Nawaz discussed more with Nick Timiraos

entries.title: Groundbreaking treatments and vaccines offer hope in fight against cancer
entries.snippet: There have been several promising developments lately in cancer research and treatment, including a new drug approved by the FDA this week for advanced pancreatic cancer. William Brangham reports.

entries.title: National parks under strain from Trump's construction projects and political pressure
entries.snippet: Americans continue to flock to the national parks, with more than 320 million visitors in the last year alone. But that broad appeal is facing new political pressures, from orders to revise exhibits to President Trump's construction projects. Amna Nawaz discussed the state of nat

entries.title: Brooks and Capehart on Trump's 'forever trade war'
entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW join Geoff Bennett to discuss the week in politics, including President Trump's trade war and dispute with Canada, the legal fight over mail-in ballots, the public backlash to AI and data centers and the loss of Dolly P

entries.title: Riley Downing sings about the overlooked corners of American life in 'Landfill Poetry'
entries.snippet: Riley Downing is a founding member of The Deslondes, the New Orleans Americana band known for its earthy mix of country soul and roots music. Now on his second solo album, "Landfill Poetry," Downing turns stories from his days working as a trash collector in Missouri into songs a

entries.title: National Park Service backs Trump's arch, despite its impact on key Washington sightlines
entries.snippet: A new National Park Service report backs President Donald Trump's proposed arch, despite what it says are adverse effects to the sightline between a host of iconic landmarks in Washington, including the Washington Monument and Lincoln and Jefferson memorials.

entries.title: Tennessee's governor boosts fan-led push to rename Nashville airport for Dolly Parton
entries.snippet: Long before 80-year-old Parton died Tuesday, fans in January 2025 started an online petition calling for officials to rename Nashville International Airport in her honor. It got renewed attention following Parton's death, jumping to more than 155,000 signatures Friday.

entries.title: Why the tween years are a good time to talk to your kids about AI
entries.snippet: Caregivers can help kids understand how AI works by turning to questions that address how these products are designed, why they were built this way and how they make kids feel.

entries.title: Ebola outbreak in Congo spreads to 2 new health zones, bringing total to 60 areas affected
entries.snippet: The two new zones affected are Biena and Manguredjipa in Congo's North Kivu province, where the case fatality rate is much higher than the overall rate of 48%, due in part to delayed response efforts, according to Congo's Ministry of Health data.

entries.title: Far-right British provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos arrested by ICE in New Orleans
entries.snippet: U.S. immigration officials arrested controversial British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos on Thursday in New Orleans, according to the Department of Homeland Security.

entries.title: Kentucky woman indicted on charges related to World War II Memorial damage
entries.snippet: Melissa Farris is scheduled to be arraigned next week on two felony counts. Grand jurors indicted her Thursday on charges of destroying the veterans' memorial and destroying government property.

entries.title: U.S. targets Egyptian bank's UAE branches under new push for Iran's economic isolation
entries.snippet: Under a new rule proposed Friday by the Treasury Department, the Emirati branches of Banque Misr, Egypt's second-largest bank, would be severed from access to the U.S. financial system.

entries.title: Washington chemical tank was called unfit for service before deadly failure, investigators find
entries.snippet: The U.S. Chemical Safety Board's update about the May 26 failure in Longview, which expelled enough caustic liquid to blow out building walls, is part of an ongoing investigation. The federal agency said it is still determining the cause of the failure.

entries.title: Trump loses again in bid to erase his hush money conviction
entries.snippet: It is the third time Judge Alvin K. Hellerstein has blocked Trump from having the U.S. District Court in Manhattan seize control of the case from the New York court where he was tried and convicted.

entries.title: Norway's crown prince becomes King Haakon VIII after his father's death
entries.snippet: Crown Prince Haakon, 53, became King Haakon VIII when his father, Harald V, died Friday at 89. Haakon adopted the motto, "All for Norway," that dates back to his great-grandfather.

entries.title: Judge says Pentagon's measures against Anthropic were 'illegal and baseless'
entries.snippet: A federal judge has ruled in favor of artificial intelligence company Anthropic in its legal battle against the Pentagon after the government labeled the company as a supply chain risk earlier this year.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Germany news: Sick leave wage bill doubles in 15 years
entries.snippet: German firms paid out a record €86 billion in wages to employees on sick leave last year, according to new research. Meanwhile, dozens of firefighters tackled a blaze at a refugee home in Berlin overnight. DW has more.

entries.title: Russian strike on warehouse near Kyiv kills dozens
entries.snippet: Hundreds were also forced to evacuate after a Russian attack on a warehouse near Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, sparked a huge fire and explosions.

entries.title: US, Ecuador forces strike alleged drug smuggling boat
entries.snippet: Tackling drug trafficking in Latin America is a key priority for Washington. In March, Ecuador joined a US-led coalition to combat the drug trade in the region.

entries.title: Death toll from Nepal-Tibet floods rises to over 600
entries.snippet: Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region.

entries.title: South Korea leans toward military conscription for women
entries.snippet: Facing a population decline, fewer potential service members and calls for social equality to be extended to national military service, Korea is inching closer to breaking the taboo on women on the front line.

entries.title: This extremely successful author polarizes German readers
entries.snippet: She's young and she says what she thinks: Caroline Wahl is topping Germany's bestseller lists with her novels. But she has also faced public backlash.

entries.title: Serbia: Keeping EU, Russia in play ahead of key election
entries.snippet: As Serbia heads towards an uncertain election, President Aleksandar Vucic is balancing ties with Russia and EU ambitions. But growing geopolitical tensions and pressure at home are narrowing his room to maneuver.

entries.title: Iceland holds knife-edge referendum on EU membership talks
entries.snippet: The Nordic nation shelved earlier plans to join the EU over fishing rights, but geopolitics, including Trump's threat to seize Greenland, has prompted a rethink.

entries.title: India news: PM Modi leaves for Central Asian tour
entries.snippet: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is traveling to Uzbekistan for a two-day state visit, after which he will go to Kyrgyzstan for the SCO Summit. Meanwhile, hundreds of Indians are still missing in Nepal. DW has more.

entries.title: Nearly 200,000 forced deportees received by Haiti, UN says
entries.snippet: Amid surging gang violence, Haiti received thousands of forced returnees. An emergency meeting of the UN Security Council was called to discuss the situation in Haiti following a deadly gang attack.

entries.title: US, Venezuela announce 'historic' oil deal
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump announced an agreement with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil. The South American country has the largest proven oil reserves in the world.

entries.title: US arrests far-right provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos
entries.snippet: Yiannopoulos, a far-right commentator, was an early supporter of Donald Trump and his immigration crackdown, but they have since fallen out. DHS said he was an "illegal alien" who overstayed his visit in the US.

entries.title: Spain asks EU's Frontex for help in processing Ceuta migrants
entries.snippet: Of the over 70,000 migrants who illegally crossed into Ceuta from Morocco in late July, some 5,000 still remain in the Spanish exclave. Ceuta residents have been angrily protesting their continued presence.

entries.title: Austria museum heist: Thieves snatch diamond necklace
entries.snippet: The stolen necklace, studded with 673 precious stones, belonged to Egypt's Queen Nazli. It was being displayed as part of the museum's exhibition for designs by France's Van Cleef and Arpels.

entries.title: Germany news: Baltic summit plans hybrid-threat task force
entries.snippet: Ministers from countries bordering the Baltic Sea have agreed on a rapid response force to counter hybrid threats. Meanwhile, the far-right AfD has failed to topple a state premier. DW has more updates from Germany.

entries.title: What next? Kurds say yes, Druze still say no to united Syria
entries.snippet: The Druze minority in Sweida, Syria, is now the only group that hasn't accepted central government authority. How does the end of an independent Kurdish area impact Druze plans for a different, divided kind of Syria?

entries.title: Germany: Man gets life in jail for US tourist's rape, murder
entries.snippet: The crime was unsolved for over three decades before new DNA proof made it possible to arrest and convict the now 81-year-old. His victim, Amy Lopez, was 24 at the time of her murder.

entries.title: Uganda: World's 'youngest monarch' dies aged 34
entries.snippet: Oyo Nyimba, once recognized as the world's youngest reigning monarch, has died in his mid-30s. As one of Uganda's traditional monarchs, he took the throne of the Tooro kingdom in 1995, aged just 3.

entries.title: Africa's aging autocrats fight to stay in power
entries.snippet: As some of Africa's longest-serving leaders grow older, they are using different tactics to extend their rule. But age, succession battles and public pressure pose new challenges.
